svg.title: Consistent nodal loads from a uniform traction
svg.desc: A uniform traction q on an edge of length L becomes nodal forces. A linear two-node edge receives qL/2 at each node. A quadratic three-node edge receives qL/6 at each end and 2qL/3 at the midpoint.
svg.text: uniform traction q over length L
